# LAMMPS Input Script for SiO2 NPT Quenching

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read data file
read_data       /results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_true/level_2/workflow/sio2_quenching_2_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_0/sio2_structure.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style      tersoff
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Define simulation settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    delay 10

timestep        0.001

# Define NPT ensemble for quenching
fix             1 all npt temp 5000 1500 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Run the simulation
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press vol density
run             10000

# Unfix the NPT ensemble
unfix           1
